meta.title: Bloque Tolima (CNMH, Dirección de Acuerdos de la Verdad)
meta.maker: Centro Nacional de Memoria Histórica (CNMH), Colombia
meta.note: All layers of the CNMH report map on the paramilitary Bloque Tolima, read in full with each feature tagged by its source_layer (presence and influence zones and fronts by period, plus the report's other layers such as massacres, bases and context maps); the server generalised polygons at 0.0005 degrees (about 55 m) when read.
